subject: Vendor onboarding + PO exemption documentation request (Acme Payments)
messages:
From: Sophie Hart <sophie.hart@acmepay.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@acme.com
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: Register Redwood as vendor + PO VAT exemption question

Hi Karthik,

We're preparing to pay Redwood for the integration work scheduled later this month. Before we can process the first invoice our AP team needs Redwood registered as a vendor in Acme's supplier portal. Two items AP flagged that I wanted to surface early:

1) PO reference: Our system requires the official PO number to appear on the invoice in the header and in the filename for automated matching.
2) VAT handling: Acme is claiming reverse-charge for intra-EU services. Can Redwood provide an EU VAT registration or a VAT-exemption certificate? If Redwood is not VAT-registered in the EU, please confirm whether you will issue invoices net-of-VAT and provide the appropriate evidence.

Can you share your onboarding packet and the routing for bank details so we can provision you as a vendor? AP would also like a primary billing contact and a plan for how future POs are referenced.

Thanks,
– Sophie
Sophie Hart
Senior AP Operations
Acme Payments
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sophie Hart <sophie.hart@acmepay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Register Redwood as vendor + PO VAT exemption question

Hi Sophie — thanks for the heads up.

I've attached our standard AP onboarding form and bank details template; I'll work with Finance to confirm the VAT position. Short answers up front:

- PO reference: we'll ensure every invoice includes the supplied PO number in the invoice header and file name (format: invoice_<PO>_YYYYMMDD.pdf).
- VAT: Redwood is a US entity without EU VAT registration for this legal entity. We typically support reverse-charge for EU customers when they provide their VAT ID and a valid exemption claim. Finance needs a copy of the customer's VAT ID and a statement of reverse-charge applicability from Acme to accept a net invoice.

Laura (cc) will confirm the exact documents we need from your side and whether any additional tax forms are required. Once we have the VAT evidence and completed onboarding form we will ask AP to create Redwood as a vendor and return an Acme-assigned vendor ID and PO acceptance window.

I attached: Acme_AP_Onboarding_Form.pdf and Bank_Details_Template.xlsx.

Next steps:
- Sophie: please upload the completed onboarding form + Acme VAT ID (if applicable) to the Docu link or reply with attachments.
- Laura: please confirm Redwood's required tax evidence for net-of-VAT acceptance.

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Sophie Hart <sophie.hart@acmepay.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Register Redwood as vendor + PO VAT exemption question

Hi Sophie — looping in Finance. A few specifics from our side to make vendor creation and invoice matching smooth:

- Required fields on invoice: PO number, Redwood legal name (Redwood Inference, Inc.), Redwood tax ID (EIN: 12-3456789), invoice date, invoice number, line-level descriptions and amounts, and the Acme-assigned vendor ID once you have it.
- VAT / reverse-charge: if Acme claims reverse-charge, please provide (1) Acme's VAT ID, (2) a short written statement from your tax/finance team confirming reverse-charge applies for these services, and (3) a copy of any VAT exemption certificate your AP requires. We will accept net-of-VAT invoices once we have those items on file.
- Bank details: send completed Bank_Details_Template.xlsx; we prefer ACH/EU SEPA depending on bank. For SEPA we need IBAN + BIC.
- PO timing & payment terms: our standard payment terms are NET45 for new vendor setups; if you require earlier terms we can escalate but need procurement approval.

Attachments requested: completed AP onboarding form, W-8BEN (or W-9 if tax residence changes), VAT_Exemption_Certificate (if applicable), completed Bank_Details_Template.xlsx.

I'll start a vendor creation ticket internally and will share the Acme vendor number when created. If you want us to accept self-billing (Acme issues the invoice on Redwood's behalf), let us know — that requires a signed self-billing agreement and changes to remittance.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
